review_notes: I read the whole 39-line file. It has two theorems. i301ARowCfg_suz fills in the structure fields from existing row_* lemmas. i301ARow_suz applies i301ARow_of_model. The two proofs share no nontrivial reasoning with each other. I also compared CFSG/Sporadic/Co2I301/Row.lean, which has a similar layout. The two files differ in the hR0t, hMax and hd proofs. A shared lemma would only wrap existing API or move routine branches into a helper, which the rubric says is insufficient. I found no justified finding.
